description: Real NVENC H.264 encoder backend (T-017a). Implementation complete in commit 39484a3: cuInit → cuDeviceGetCount → NvEncodeAPICreateInstance → nvEncOpenEncodeSessionEx probe chain, plus configure/push_frame/drain/init_segment/teardown with fMP4 output. 139 unit tests pass including nvenc_probe_available_when_hardware_present on RTX 4080 SUPER (driver 595.71.05). HOWEVER: T-021 rerun 5 (2026-05-19) shows encoder.probeResult returning available=false with reason nvenc-api-create-failed:15 at runtime. NvEncodeAPICreateInstance returned status 15. ISS-002 has been reopened with this runtime evidence. Investigate why the probe succeeds in tests but fails in the runner-spawned helper subprocess.
